mapper.select: SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM( SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} )

SELECT SUM (num) FROM( SELECT COUNT(TRADE_ID) num FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(TRADE_ID) num FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId})
